description:
Calm Music | Sitar for Cortisol Reset

If your jaw is clenched and your shoulders are at your ears — start here. Cortisol's been doing too much. Let the strings unwind it.

Solo sitar playing Raga Bhairavi (deep healing raga, rendered for evening contemplation), tuned to 432Hz, with a subliminal Theta wave layer for nervous-system grounding and stress hormone reset.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Solo sitar — seven-string Indian plucked instrument with characteristic meend glissando slides and gamak ornamentation
- Raga Bhairavi — deep classical healing raga, contemplative and grounding
- 432Hz — healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- Subliminal Theta wave (5Hz) entrainment layer
- Seamless looping texture, no abrupt transitions

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first conscious breaths
12:00  Cortisol releasing — body softening
35:00  Nervous system grounding
60:00  Deep ground state
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Let it run uninterrupted. Don't try to relax — the frequencies do the work. Breathe through your nose. Your shoulders will drop on their own.

⏱ Best for:
• Cortisol reset / end-of-day stress
• Wired-but-tired evenings
• Post-work decompression
• Nervous system grounding
• Generalized anxiety relief
